BL-1084 — A supersede note reaches one role while copies of the work are already moving down the pipeline, so superseded work ships past every stage in front of it
What it solves: The report that produced this ticket is worth reading for a second reason:
it is a clean example of the Guardrails rule that a merge must be diffed
against BOTH parents. The merge itself reported nothing but "Merge made by
the 'ort' strategy"; the superseded content was visible only in that diff.
Approval context: Filed medium rather than high, deliberately, because the expedite lane is already carrying nine or ten critical/high defects and the human has twice asked to unblock the queue-jump batch.
The case for high is real and worth seeing: superseded, unapproved work did reach `main`, past four review stag…
BL-1084 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1084" (or "reject BL-1084 <reason>") to act.
